definitions.explanation: A bar or structure along the edge of stairs, balconies, bridges, or other elevated places, designed to be held for support or to prevent falling.

examples.japanese: {手|て}すり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧つかまって⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please hold on to the handrail.

examples.japanese: ⟦{階段|かいだん}→階段：00782_kaidan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{手|て}すり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{壊|こわ}れている→壊れる：00791_kowareru⟧。
⟦バルコニー→バルコニー：06772_barukonii⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{手|て}すり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧もたれて⟦{景色|けしき}→景色：01395_keshiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{眺|なが}めた→眺める：02132_nagameru⟧。
examples.english: I leaned against the balcony railing and gazed at the scenery.

notes:
{手|て}すり refers to any handrail or railing — on stairs, balconies, bridges, walkways, etc. The kanji form {手摺|てすり} exists but kana or mixed writing ({手|て}すり) is more common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {手|て}すり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧つかまる: to hold on to the handrail
- {手|て}すり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧もたれる: to lean on the railing
- ⟦{階段|かいだん}→階段：00782_kaidan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{手|て}すり: stair railing
- {手|て}すり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設置|せっち}する→設置する：26989_secchisuru⟧: to install a handrail
- {手|て}すり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{握|にぎ}る→握る：02383_nigiru⟧: to grip the handrail

TYPES:
- ⟦{階段|かいだん}→階段：00782_kaidan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{手|て}すり: stair handrail
- ⟦ベランダ→ベランダ：05072_beranda⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{手|て}すり: balcony railing
- ⟦{橋|はし}→橋：02163_hashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{手|て}すり: bridge railing

CULTURAL NOTE:
Public announcements in trains and stations often remind passengers: {手|て}すり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧おつかまり⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧ (Please hold on to the handrail).
